title: The Healer's Garden
description: Edda's youngest has been feverish since the thin planting, and the family cannot spare the coin for a Dalhurst healer. Priestess Elara teaches the healing side of her faith the same way she teaches everything else - by need, not by lesson plan. Gather moonleaf, silvervine and sunroot, and the temple will grind them into something that actually helps.

objectives.description: Gather Moonleaf from Elder Moor forests
Deliver the herbs before the fever gets worse

notes: Threat: a sick child in the household introduced in gaela_01, named to keep the arc's stakes concrete rather than abstract healing-lesson flavor. Giver motive: Elara teaches by pointing at a real fever, not a hypothetical one. Consequence: not wired; carries into gaela_03 where the same farm is attacked by wolves and rats.
